_meta.method: Independent labels: 10 WebSearch queries (standard mode) on used/sold prices for the higher-value or model-specific items (Aeron, Kallax, FG800, MacBook Air M2, Dell 27in, Micke, TCL 32in, sofa, fridge, Sony XM4), combined with model knowledge of typical SF Bay Area Facebook Marketplace / Craigslist / eBay-sold prices. No app data was used. Generic commodity items (wastebasket, shelf, lamp, bottle, duffel, etc.) are knowledge-based estimates with no specific source. usd = typical local selling price, good condition; low/high = plausible band.

backpack.basis: knowledge: generic mid-range (JanSport/North Face-class) used backpacks on FB/eBay typically $10-40

bicycle.basis: knowledge: used ordinary hybrid/commuter (Trek FX/Giant Escape-class) on Bay Area Craigslist/FB commonly $150-350; department-store bikes lower

black flat screen tv.basis: knowledge: generic ~50in 4K smart TVs are ~$250-300 new; used local typically $100-200

black floating wall shelf.basis: knowledge: commodity item, ~$15-30 new; used often $5-15 or free

black mesh back office chair with patter.basis: knowledge: generic task chair, used local $15-60

black rectangular plastic wastebasket.basis: knowledge: ~$5-15 new; used resale minimal, often bundled/free

dell 27 inch monitor.basis: web: eBay sold/listed used Dell 27in P27xxH/U27xx ~$75-115 (U2721DE sold ~$110, P2719H ~GBP110); 1440p models higher; model-dependent

floor lamp.basis: knowledge: generic floor lamp used $5-30 on FB

gray metal twin bunk bed with ladder.basis: knowledge: metal twin-over-twin ~$150-250 new; used local $50-150; bulky, slow seller

herman miller office chair.basis: web: used Aeron reports ~$400-900 (forum $650 for loaded 2016; SF listing $850 asking; refurb dealers $500-1000+); Bay Area has heavy office-liquidation supply, so private-party used often $300-600

ikea kallax shelf.basis: web: FINN (Norway) used 2x4 Kallax ~1/3-1/2 of new price; US new ~$90-100 -> used ~$35-60; knowledge of FB Bay Area $40-70

ikea micke desk.basis: web: AptDeco used Micke listed $50-55 vs ~$100 new; local FB usually a bit lower

mesh office chair.basis: knowledge: generic mesh task chair used $20-70

mini fridge.basis: knowledge: 3-4 cu ft compact fridge ~$130-200 new; used $40-90 (college move-out supply)

mirror.basis: knowledge: generic full-length mirror used $10-50; framed floor mirrors higher

refrigerator.basis: web (low-quality guides): full-size used $150-400, family-size/French door $400-800; knowledge of Bay Area Craigslist

sofa.basis: knowledge only (search returned no usable data): mainstream 3-seat sofa resale typically 20-40% of retail; wide variance, many free/cheap listings

tcl 32 inch tv.basis: web: new TCL 32in Roku often $88-128; one eBay sale ~$97 incl. Blu-ray player; used listings $20-100

teal insulated water bottle.basis: knowledge: Hydro Flask ~$35-45 new; used resale $8-20

vacuum.basis: knowledge: mainstream upright (Shark/Bissell/Hoover) used $30-80; Dyson uprights higher

silver thin laptop.basis: web: used MacBook Air M2 value checker $620-820, refurb ~$558; 8GB/256GB base lower; ~3-yr-old M2 private sale ~$550-700

white over-ear headphones.basis: web: Amazon 3rd-party used Sony XM4 ~$230 (inflated asking), historic used lows ~$100; knowledge: local/eBay used Sony XM4/Beats Studio $90-160

yamaha acoustic guitar.basis: web: used FG800 Guitar Center $180, eBay $200 listed, damaged $100; private-party local typically $120-170

white drum shade standing floor lamp wit.basis: knowledge: generic Target/IKEA-style drum-shade floor lamp, ~$30-50 new; used $10-25
